spend.label: Monthly license spend
spend.explainer: Assigned seats × the monthly price of each product, summed across your license inventory.
spend.formula: For every product we multiply the seats assigned to people by that product's monthly price, then add them up.
spend.source: Seat counts come from your latest sync; prices come from your price book (your custom price, or the Microsoft list price as a fallback).

waste.label: Monthly waste
waste.explainer: The monthly cost of every open finding added together — this is the spend you could reclaim.
waste.formula: Each open or acknowledged finding carries the monthly cost of the wasted seat. Monthly waste is the sum of those costs, grouped here by the rule that flagged them.
waste.source: Findings are raised during sync by the detection rules; resolved findings are excluded. Costs reuse the same prices as monthly spend.
waste.emptyText: No open findings — nothing flagged as waste.

annual.label: Annualized waste
annual.explainer: Monthly waste projected over a full year: monthly waste × 12.
annual.formula: Monthly waste × 12 months. A projection of what the open findings cost over a year if nothing is reclaimed.
annual.source: Same findings as monthly waste, each multiplied by twelve.
annual.emptyText: No open findings — nothing flagged as waste.

findings.label: Open findings
findings.explainer: How many findings are currently open or acknowledged, across all detection rules.
findings.formula: A count of every finding whose status is open or acknowledged. Resolved findings drop out of the count.
findings.source: Findings are raised during sync by {count} detection rules. Each rule flags a distinct kind of license waste.
findings.footnote: {withFindings} of {total} rules currently have open findings.

savings.label: Verified savings (30d)
savings.explainer: Monthly recurring waste that disappeared after a later sync confirmed the affected license was reclaimed.
savings.formula: Monthly impact from findings automatically resolved during the last 30 days.
savings.source: A later sync must confirm the waste condition no longer exists; acknowledging a finding does not count as savings.
savings.emptyText: No findings were confirmed resolved in the last 30 days.
